name: Dr. Melanie Smith
reason: Her work is mainly clinical and sold on health: search results describe her as a Doctor of Oriental Medicine with an integrative clinical practice (Well Within Natural Medicine, St. Petersburg, Florida) and an Eden Energy Medicine teacher, and every Shift course in the lead is health-framed (heart health, the ageing brain, the vagus nerve's 'power to heal', 5G electromagnetic resiliency), so almost nothing would pass the health-claim rule. No own website was found in one search, so nothing was confirmed on her own pages; theshiftnetwork.com refuses our fetches.
